notes.title: MAINFRAMES - Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Greetings!✨

It’s now been two months since MainFrames is officially in your hands! 💾

First and foremost, we want to thank everyone who has been playing our game!
Today, we’re back with an update in order to provide you with the smoothest cyber-adventure by fixing some issues: 

Patch Notes - MainFrames [1.1.0]

 Adelie’s Hints: Some players had some trouble spotting the secret shortcuts to get around the game’s difficulty spikes. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149160/2438f904383396cd9c216eb28ab42f62b7823394.png
So, we asked Adelie to appear after a certain number of Floppy’s attempts to give a hint when there’s a secret shortcut in the room.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149160/b0fc1a442f1705f85233158562234308d40547bc.png
 Levels Selection: You can now load any level you’ve already visited at any given point during the game from the pause menu and see its completion percentage.
 Floppy <: We made some staging adjustments to ensure that everyone can understand the game’s story without any issues.
 db Theo: Some of you were quite disappointed not to know the names of certain characters, so we’ve added them at the beginning of each dialogue.
 More explosions: We added more explosions in order to have more explosions.
 Bug fixes: After a well-deserved rest and coffee break, the mini-daemons are now 100% operational and appear after each failed attempt instead of napping.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149160/87d0c6d0b85c59cc634c07ff5e87c8fe8dd50a96.png

This update is very important to us because it aligns much more with our vision of the game, the one we wish we had delivered at launch. We thank you for your patience and hope you’ll get the chance to enjoy the hard work of all the daemons and process who gave their all to make sure you have a great time! 💗

<,
Theo

Play MainFrames Now!
Time for you to jump into this cyber adventure, and don’t forget to leave a review – it would make Floppy very happy!💾💖

notes.title: MAINFRAMES - HOTFIX 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Greetings!✨

First and foremost, we would like to thank everyone who has been playing MainFrames! We hope you’re having loads of fun hopping between frames and navigating the digital world!

To ensure that you're having the best gaming experience, we've just released a new patch that fixes the following:

 Undeletion achievement can now be unlocked
 Crypto-shredding achievement can now be unlocked
 The tutorial display now updates itself when the player rebinds the buttons
